adjudication.rationale: The finding correctly identifies that in LarkCalendarService.createEvent(), the code uses `const [mainHostDestinationCalendar] = event.destinationCalendar ?? []` to always extract only the first destination calendar. For collective team events where multiple hosts have different destination calendars (as shown in handleNewBooking.ts where teamDestinationCalendars are pushed to evt.destinationCalendar), the Lark calendar service will only use the first host's calendar ID for all credentials. Unlike GoogleCalendarService which was updated to accept a credentialId parameter and find the matching destination calendar (`calEventRaw.destinationCalendar?.find(cal => cal.credentialId === credentialId)`), LarkCalendarService was not updated with this pattern. This means secondary collective hosts using Lark calendar will have events created in the wrong calendar.
